reason: E2 directly supports the ~20% yield strength increase and improved corrosion resistance for 5 at% Mo in CrCoNiFe, but provides no evidence for reduced creep, local ordering, or passive film mechanisms. E1 is a generic overview of HEAs and offers no specific support for any premise. Thus, only two of five key premises are supported by the cited evidence.
premises: Mo addition to CrCoNiFe HEA increases yield strength by ~20%
Mo addition to CrCoNiFe HEA improves corrosion resistance in 3.5 wt% NaCl
Mo addition retards diffusion and reduces room-temperature creep
Mo promotes local chemical ordering and fine Mo-rich features that hinder dislocations
Mo promotes a more stable, protective passive oxide film
